content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The proposed infrastructure utilizes GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. This combination provides a robust and scalable solution, allowing creators to maintain full ownership and control over their digital commerce stack. By leveraging crypto payments through NOWPayments, creators can bypass traditional payment gateways and their associated fees, such as the 10% charge imposed by Gumroad, which can retain up to $921 at 100 sales per month on a $97 product.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need to prepare your digital products, such as ebooks, courses, or templates, and ensure they are ready for sale. You also need to set up a crypto wallet to receive payments and choose a suitable cryptocurrency, like USDT or Bitcoin, for your transactions. Additionally, you should familiarize yourself with the technical requirements and tools involved in the deployment process, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you will need to integrate NOWPayments with your digital commerce stack. This involves creating a NOWPayments account, generating an API key, and configuring the payment gateway to work with your chosen cryptocurrency. You will also need to set up automated delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring that customers receive their digital products instantly upon payment confirmation.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks eliminate platform fees, giving creators more control over their sales.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have deployed your sovereign digital commerce stack and set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live and start processing transactions. This involves testing your setup to ensure that payments are being processed correctly and that customers are receiving their digital products as expected. You should also monitor your sales and analytics to identify areas for improvement and optimize your stack accordingly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital commerce stack grows, you may need to scale your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and sales. This can involve upgrading your hosting plan, optimizing your backend logic, or adding more storage to your order management system. By leveraging the scalability of cloud-based services like Cloudflare Pages or Supabase, you can easily adapt your infrastructure to meet the demands of your growing business, ensuring that your customers continue to receive a seamless and reliable shopping experience.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use a sovereign digital commerce stack that leverages crypto payments through NOWPayments. This solution allows you to maintain full ownership and control over your sales process, eliminating the need for traditional payment gateways and their associated fees. By utilizing a combination of GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, you can create a robust and scalable ecommerce platform that enables you to sell digital products directly to your customers.
Crypto payments through NOWPayments reduce transaction fees to 0.5%, increasing creator earnings.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For creators looking to build and deploy their own sovereign digital commerce stack, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything needed to get started. This comprehensive package includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and instant access to the necessary tools and resources. You can purchase the Complete Builder Kit and access other products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, enabling you to take control of your digital commerce and start selling ebooks, courses, and other digital products with crypto payments.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, start by setting up your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting, then configure your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic. Next, integrate NOWPayments with your stack, and set up automated delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Test your setup to ensure that payments are being processed correctly, and monitor your sales and analytics to identify areas for improvement. Finally, optimize and scale your infrastructure as needed to handle increased traffic and sales, ensuring a seamless and reliable shopping experience for your customers.
